tagline: Noise hi-hat synth with band-pass tone and open/closed decay
description: A hi-hat voice made from white noise filtered to a high band, shaped by an exponential decay and soft-clipped. Any MIDI note triggers the same hat, with velocity setting the level; there is no open/closed choke between notes.

features.name: Band-Pass Noise
features.description: Three high-pass and three low-pass one-pole stages keep the noise between a 4-8 kHz lower edge (set by Tone) and 12 kHz.

features.name: Openness
features.description: Lengthens the decay by up to 2 times, from closed toward open.

features.name: Metallic
features.description: Raises the level into a tanh saturator by up to 3 times for a harder, more saturated hat; it adds no metallic oscillators.
